'''5000''' ('''five thousand''') is the [[natural number]] following 4999 and preceding 5001. Five thousand is, at the same time, the largest [[Heterogram (literature)|isogrammic]] numeral, and the smallest number that contains every one of the five [[vowel]]s (a, e, i, o, u) unrepeated in certain dialects of the [[English language]] (i.e. those that do not include the word “and” when writing out 230, 250, 260, 602, and 640).

{{Wiktionary|five thousand}}
